standings.title: Overall standings
standings.helpDns: DNS (did not start): 0 points and it does count toward dropped rounds.
standings.helpDsq: DSQ (disqualified): same as DNS for dropped rounds (0 pts, uses a drop slot).
standings.helpAbsent: Not entered in that event (— cell): no row is created and it does not use a drop slot.
standings.helpCounting: The best {{count}} scores count; the rest are struck through, including a DNS if it is among the worst.
standings.helpCountingUnset: If you set “counting races”, the best N scores are kept and the worst are dropped (including DNS).
standings.helpOverride: A points adjustment (“adjusted” badge) replaces that event’s calculated result or DNS/DSQ when totaling the standings.
standings.countingSummary: Worst events are dropped; the best {{count}} scores count.
standings.empty: No standings yet. They are calculated when events have results or are closed.
standings.emptyNoEvents: This league has no linked events yet.
standings.emptyNoEventsHint: Without events there are no columns or points. Link competitions so they can feed the standings.
standings.emptyNoResults: Events are linked, but none feed the standings yet.
standings.emptyNoResultsHint: A closed event always counts. Running or published events only count once they have timings.
standings.emptyNoParticipants: There are no drivers in the standings yet.
standings.emptyNoParticipantsHint: Add league entries or close an event with results. Mark a registered no-show as DNS.
standings.emptyCountingUnset: No dropped-round limit is set: every result row (including DNS/DSQ) counts.
standings.emptyCountingUnsetOrganizer: In Edit league, “counting races” keeps the best N scores and drops the worst.
standings.emptyOrganizerHint: For a league driver no-show, mark DNS on that event cell once standings columns appear.
standings.organizerHint: Tap a cell to mark DNS/DSQ or adjust points for a league-registered driver.
standings.markedDns: Marked DNS (0 pts, counts toward drops)
standings.markedDsq: Marked DSQ (0 pts, counts toward drops)
standings.adjustPointsHelp: If the club sheet does not match the automatic score, enter the official points for this driver in this event. The adjustment replaces the result, DNS or DSQ. Removing it restores the automatic value.
standings.adjustReasonHint: E.g. corrected results sheet, lap recount…
standings.adjustCleared: Adjustment removed; automatic value is used

mySeason.helpCounting: The best {{count}} events count. Dropped rounds are listed explicitly, not only in a tooltip.
mySeason.helpCountingUnset: Every event with a result counts; no dropped-round limit is set.
mySeason.helpDnsVsAbsent: DNS (0 pts) does appear and can be dropped. “Not listed” is different: no row and it does not use a drop slot.
mySeason.helpOverride: If an event is “adjusted”, those official points replace the calculated score or DNS/DSQ.
mySeason.droppedEmpty: No events have been dropped yet.
mySeason.emptyNoCompetitions: This league has no linked events yet.
mySeason.emptyNoResults: This driver has no league results yet.
mySeason.emptyNotFound: This participant was not found in the league.

calendar.title: Season calendar
calendar.subtitle: Upcoming, running and completed. If a date is missing, league order is used.
calendar.empty: No events are linked to this league yet.
calendar.emptyPublic: There are no public events on the calendar.
calendar.noDatesHint: None of the events have a date; league order and status are shown instead.
calendar.clubSectionEmpty: This club has no published leagues yet.

subtitle.standings: Dropped rounds, DNS, DSQ, tie-breaks and adjustments you see in the table.
subtitle.mySeason: How to read points, dropped rounds and the Adjusted badge on your season card.
subtitle.settings: These options change the standings immediately (recalculated on read).

drops.title: Dropped rounds
drops.counting: The best {{count}} scores count. The rest are struck through (“dropped”) and do not add to the total.
drops.unset: No “counting races” limit: every result row (including DNS/DSQ) counts. Empty or 0 means no drops.
drops.meaning: A “dropped” cell stays visible but does not add to the total. Only existing rows use a drop slot: DNS does, “not listed” does not.

dns.title: DNS (did not start)
dns.body: 0 points and it does use a drop slot. Set manually, or inferred if the driver is NP in every round of that event.

absent.title: Not listed / not entered
absent.body: A “—” cell: no row for that event. No points and it does not use a drop slot. Different from DNS.

dnf.title: DNF
dnf.body: No DNF status is inferred. Points and place come from the result recorded in the event.

dsq.title: DSQ (disqualified)
dsq.body: 0 points and the same drop-slot treatment as DNS: the row exists and occupies a slot.

tiebreak.title: Tie-breaks
tiebreak.intro: Points after drops come first. If still tied, the league’s tie-break applies.

modes.competitions_completed: more rows with points > 0 that are not dropped.
modes.most_wins: more first places (position 1) that are not dropped.
modes.last_race_position: better place in the last scoring event that is not dropped and has a position.

tiebreak.fallback: If still tied, drivers are ordered by name.

override.title: Adjusted
override.body: The “Adjusted” badge is a manual points override (driver × event). That value is what totals and what enters the drop pool.
override.priority: Priority: manual override > DNS/DSQ > calculated points. Removing the override restores DNS/DSQ or the calculation (or “—” if there is no row).

scoringEvents.title: Which events feed the standings
scoringEvents.closed: Closed: always included, even with no timings (DNS/DSQ or an override can still apply).
scoringEvents.runningPublished: Running or published: only if timings are already recorded.
scoringEvents.other: Draft or other statuses: no standings column and no points.

scoring.perCompetition: This league uses per-event scoring rules. Configure the rules on each competition.

competitions.empty: No events are linked to this league yet.
competitions.emptyHint: Without events there is no calendar or standings. Add existing competitions; closed ones or those with timings feed the table.

participants.empty: No participants are entered in the league.
participants.emptyHint: Standings can also come from event results. A league entry can be marked DNS, DSQ or Adjusted.
participants.emptyImportHint: If your events already have drivers, use “Import from competitions”.
